articleTitle: A novel architecture to deliver scalable video coding contents over P2P network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduced a new architecture for scalable P2P media streaming namely SWOR. It utilizes small world peering organization on overlay to deal with the existing problems in chunk based streaming systems. SWOR evaluation against CS resulted in improved packet delivery and better video quality. Results also showed a significant reduction of average number of overlay hops which leads to lowering the transmission delay. The proposed SWOR architecture incorporates SVC to ensure smooth video quality delivery with guaranteed adapted QoS.

articleTitle: MPSO-based PID parameter optimization with novel evaluation function for typical control systems
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: The conventional tuning cannot respond to the performance criteria of a system comprehensively and flexibly, yet the numerical optimization methodologies, such as genetic algorithm and simplex, have shortcomings on strategy parameter selection or initial condition sensitivity. This paper propose a novel comprehensive evaluation function concerning system performance, and optimize the PID controller parameters by using Modified Particle Swarm Optimization (MPSO). Two simulation show that the proposed method performs better than conventional tuning, the design of controller can satisfy various goals, and indicates well performances under either low-order or high-order circumstances, which proved to be possessing high practical value.

articleTitle: 3-D calibration of ultrasound image for rural MRCAS
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: To reduce the cost of Medical Robotics and Computer Assisted Surgery (MRCAS) in rural medical of china, the researchers have focused on MRCAS investigation. They are inclined to select ultrasonography as medical image guidance because of its low cost, noninvasiveness and accuracy. 3-D calibration of ultrasound image is a very important technique of MRCAS. To improve the calibration precision, a method based on grid-string phantom and rapid algorithm for coordinate transformation is investigated. It accurately defines the spatial relationship between the US image plane and an external tracking device attached to the US probe. The phantom consists of two layers of grid-string planar arrays. The cross of the strings can rapidly guide the user to align the probe accurately for imaging; the cross coordinates are directly used in the algorithm for homologous points matching without any transformations. The calibration parameters are calculated by matching of homologous points in the image and the tracking device, then, the 2-D US image can be converted into 3-D US coordinates. The results show that this method can accelerate the speed of the calibration, simplify the calibration algorithm, reduce the influences of the US beam thickness on the precision and obtain the normal calibration precision and reconstruction accuracy of the 3-D US system.

Author Keywords: medical robotics and computer assisted surgery(MRCAS)

publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: IPv6 is one of the key components of next generation communication system. Depends on the observation, we proposed an information retrieval scheme based on our previous proposed eChord protocol which takes the advantage of IPv6 protocol.

articleTitle: A Markov Model-based method for buffer management in identity/locator separating network
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: Aiming at improving the query efficiency of the mapping information in the identity/locator separating network, the typical buffer management algorithms are discussed and the Markov model is researched in this paper. Then a novel method for dividing the mapping server buffer space is introduced. On this basis, a Markov Model-based algorithm is proposed. The simulation result shows that the efficiency of the method presented in this paper is improved greatly compared with the existing cache management algorithms.

articleTitle: Event Process Framework research and implementation of distributed system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the tight coupling features between system and modules in the distributed application system that implemented with components, the paper brought out an Event Process Framework (EPF), which achieves information interaction among systems in the manner of event processing. The event process mechanism referred to information interaction manner of High Level Architecture (HLA) in distributed interaction simulation and implemented event publish and subscribe with .NET Remoting technology and mapping file, so as to part the component development and EPM, which can effectively reduce the coupling among systems and improve reusability of developed components.

articleTitle: Application of GIS technology in coal mine graphic information management system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: According to the current coal mine graphic information management system's situation and existing problems, closely combining with the need of coal mine digitalization development. The paper fully applies GIS technique and modern management technique to create coal mine graphic information management system based on B/S and C/S architecture. Meanwhile, it describes the system general design, function implementation and applying example of graphic processing sub-system in details.

articleTitle: The control infrastructure for reconfigurable DSP system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: A heterogeneous embedded reconfigurable computing platform with loosely-coupled structure for DSP is constructed. Based on the platform, the signal processing task model and control model are discussed. The control unit based on finite state machine in combine to the signal processing functional unit is defined. A combination mechanism for control units is also brought out. Through the control units and combination mechanism, the hierarchical control infrastructure of the DSP system is present. The experiments show that the control infrastructure can serve the signal processing correctly and effectively.

articleTitle: G-S chaotic neural networks and its applications
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: A novel G-S chaotic neural networks is proposed based on G-S chaotic neuron, whose structure is similar to BP neural networks. The activation function is no monotonous function and the neurons have two states. In the process of learning, the states of neurons are chaotic. According to the states, the weights can be adjusted. In the process of working, the sates of neurons are not chaotic. The learning algorithm of the networks is a chaos optimization method, which can get over the disadvantages of conventional networks. The function approximation and the hysteresis modeling of piezoelectric can be resolved by the networks. The experiment results proved the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Signal processing of wireless communication simulation platform in HLA architecture
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: The performance of wireless communication system in complicated electromagnetic environment is difficult to evaluate. Building a simulation platform in HLA architecture seems to be a good solution. Transmitting flow, reception flow and interaction strategy are discussed to fit the mechanism of pRTI. By the way of low-pass equivalent, the reduced data rate of signals is suitable for software simulating, then the channel transfer model is altered correspondingly. Comparison between assessment result and Monte Carlo calculating proves the validity of signal simulation model. The HLA architecture guarantees the reusability and scalability of platform.

articleTitle: Design and realization of county land and resources management information system based on grid system
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: Taking grid system as the basic of land management, this paper focused on the establishment of county land and resources management information system based on grid system. Presentation layer, application layer and data layer were proposed to construct the frame of county land and resources management information system. After the principles of grid dividing been clear, methods and thoughts based on three-level land grid were explained in detail. And the mechanisms and processes of county land data were discussed in detail. Finally, combined with the actual design in Shapingba of Chongqing, the prototype of county land grid management information system was realized. The results provide guidance and reference for other county in land management information system.

articleTitle: Research of likely model set with system noise fuzzy adaptation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: In maneuvering target tracking, since target's maneuvering capability has greatly increased, it is more difficult to describe and found the target's movement model. Now, variable structure multiple model (VSMM) algorithm is an effective method for strong maneuvering target tracking. Based on fuzzy control theory, it is proposed that a likely model set with system noise fuzzy adaptation (FNA-LMS) algorithm using two-dimensional fuzzy controller. The system noise of each model in VSMM algorithm is adjusted by self adaptation. Monte Carlo simulation comparison shows that FNA-LMS algorithm has better performance in tracking accuracy and computing efficiency than basic likely model set algorithm. Also it is convenient for application.

articleTitle: The path analysis of “last mile” in rural information
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: Rural Information is an objective requirement of building new socialist countryside, a necessary prerequisite for the farmers' income increasing, agricultural efficiency, and rural development. Whether “Last mile” problem could well resolve is directly related to success or failure of information technology in rural areas. Resolving rural information “last mile” problem can help to narrow the urban-rural “information gap”, and eliminate the rural areas “information island.” In resolving the real issue of “last mile”, there have many bottlenecks. In this paper we try to farm individual PC+ rural information station+ bundled system of telephone, SMS, mobile phones + IPTV and other means and ways to solve the problem of rural information “last mile”.

articleTitle: A method for evaluating nearest-neighbor queries in moving object environments
publicationTitle: 2010 International Conference on Computer and Communication Technologies in Agriculture Engineering
abstract: Data uncertainty is often involved in moving object tracking applications due to reasons such as imprecise measurement or sampling errors. The nearest-neighbor queries in moving object environments are important in the applications of moving object tacking. A probabilistic method for evaluating nearest-neighbor queries for moving object tracking in moving object environments is proposed, based on the pruning and sorting of uncertain data. Simulation result shows that the proposed method outperforms other evaluating method we knew for moving objects in the times of evaluations of integrals needed and efficiency of evaluating.
